messages:
maya: Hey team — post-deploy we're seeing a spike in embeddings error rate in eu-west1, started ~3m after the roll. 5xxs on the embed service, ~12% increased latency. tagging ops-oncall and deploybot for a quick decision. :grimacing:
deploybot: deploy-check: canary stage passed initially. Current traffic 100% on v1.2.9. To roll back: `deploy rollback service/embed --to v1.2.8`. To pin: `deploy pin service/embed --version v1.2.8`
alex: ack saw it too. failing requests look like kv cache miss + timeout to the new quant path.
sam: QA logs show malformed shard mapping in a minority of hosts. looks like a config glide missed during build.
jin: can we hotfix + pin rather than full rollback? what's the blast radius?
maya: blast radius limited to eu-west1 and ~10% of pods. If we pin to 1.2.8 we buy time for a narrow hotfix deploy.
ops-oncall: If we pin now, we need at least 2 approvers and release-bot signoff during change window. We're currently inside the evening change window but still ok for emergency.
alex: +1 pin to v1.2.8. minimize customer impact.
sam: +1 pin. also recommend disabling quant-path on affected pool as mitigation.
deploybot: approval-request: 2 approvals required. Approvals received: alex, sam. Initiating pin -- ETA ~30s.
release-bot: note: pin operation will be recorded in release log. Please add a short blurb for release notes.
maya: executing mitigation: disabling quant flag on the eu-west1 node pool now: `kubectl set env ds/embed QUANT_PATH_ENABLED=false -n prod --context=eu-west1`
deploybot: pin-success: service/embed pinned to v1.2.8 (initiated by deploybot). Traffic will shift to pinned version in <60s.
ops-oncall: monitoring for 5m post-pin. set alert threshold to 3% error rate.
jin: once stabilized, we'll schedule a hotfix image build with fixed config and a canary in 15m. who owns the image?
maya: I'll own the hotfix build and single-canary rollout. will also draft release note: "hotfix: fix embed shard mapping regression causing elevated error rates in eu-west1; pinned to v1.2.8 during emergency"
alex: FYI triage: follow-up ticket created EDGE-4123 with rollback criteria and postmortem checklist.
sam: thanks everyone. if pin holds for 10m and errors drop, thumbs up to proceed with hotfix canary. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: errors dropping to baseline. continuing to watch for 10m.
deploybot: deploybot: canary-deploy queued: `deploy canary service/embed --image app:v1.2.9-hotfix-embed --region eu-west1 --percent 5` — awaiting manual trigger after ops-ok.
maya: ops-oncall please trigger canary when you're green. I'll push the image in parallel.
ops-oncall: triggering canary now.
release-bot: log entry updated: emergency pin + canary scheduled. remember to add a short release note and mark incident impact.
maya: thanks all — will post a short deploy note once canary verifies.
jin: great coordination. postmortem to follow if we need it.
_meta: generated for dataset; single-thread Slack conversation about expedited hotfix coordination and pinning
